thread:
maria: quick check — final copy pass for the tri-mode landing (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). goal: one coherent hero, plus mode-specific subheads and CTAs. can we also map launch posts + webinar CTA -> inbound routing?

devon: +1. thinking we run a cohort test for headlines. two variants: "Predictable LLM inference at any scale" vs "Ship LLM features faster with cost-led controls". which would you prefer for the hero?

kevin: prefer the first for enterprise-lean audiences (trust/perf). second for product teams (velocity/cost). maybe we toggle by traffic source.

sophie: agree with kevin. suggestion: single hero that leans on reliability then a 3-up below showing Hosted / Dedicated / Private with tailored CTAs: try-now (hosted), request-demo (dedicated), contact-sales (private).

alec: for launch posts + webinar comms, can we route webinar signups to a 30-day nurture for Dedicated leads? they should hit sales-asst > AE queue if > certain engagement score.

maria: yes — proposed routing: webinar -> tag:tri-mode-webinar -> if company_size >50k or security tag present -> route to AE queue. otherwise, send to product nurture (self-serve playbooks).

devon: copy tweaks for the three cards (short): Hosted: "Fastest time-to-value: simple REST + curated models"; Dedicated: "Predictable throughput & reserved GPU capacity"; Private: "VPC & on-prem for regulated workloads". thoughts?

kevin: keep them tight. maybe change Dedicated to "SLA-backed reserved capacity for production apps". emphasise SLA for procurement docs.

sophie: also add a microcopy line under each CTA for expected time-to-contact: e.g., "AE replies within 1 business day" for request-demo. reduces friction.

maria: great. marketing ops: can we add UTM rules so that webinar posts and launch tweets feed a different landing variant (headline A/B + Dedicated-first)? @alec please confirm with growth.

alec: will do. i'll set cohort tags: webinar-cohort-A (headline A) and webinar-cohort-B (headline B). growth will run 50/50 for first 48h then we analyze conversion & MQL quality.

launch-bot: Deploy scheduled: /deploy marketing/landing/tri-mode-copy v3 -> staging @ 2025-11-03T15:00Z

devon: small note on benchmark narratives — landing needs a short section "unit economics" with 2 bullets: batching & caching reduce per-token cost; quantization profiles cut infra spend. keep it non-technical but tangible (e.g., "up to 3x lower per-token cost").

maria: agreed. we'll add a one-line metric and link to a longer benchmark page. can someone draft the short metric language?

kevin: i'll draft two options by EOD: conservative ("reduce unit cost by up to 2x") and aggressive ("up to 3x in specific workloads").

sophie: final checklist for copy pass: 1) hero A/B text 2) 3-up cards copy + CTA microcopy 3) benchmark micro-metric + link 4) webinar CTA routing + UTMs 5) inbound routing rules doc. i can compile and send to growth & sales.

maria: perfecto. target: ship staging copy by tomorrow noon, run the cohort test for one week, prep webinar comms for next Tues. tagging action items: @devon (headline variants + benchmark metric), @kevin (SLA phrasing + MQL threshold), @alec (UTM + routing config), @sophie (final checklist & launch doc).

devon: noted. i'll put drafts in the copy folder and ping here when ready. :rocket:

alec: will sync with growth on the routing playbook and confirm AE queue thresholds.

maria: thanks team — small, measurable experiment. short follow-up thread with links when drafts are up. :thumbsup:
